from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,importlib.metadata as md,json,sys,zipfile
import agentsync
wheel=Path(sys.argv[1]);root=Path(sys.prefix).resolve();d=md.distribution('agentsync-local')
assert Path(agentsync.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(root)
assert d.version=='0.3.0a116'
direct=json.loads(d.read_text('direct_url.json'))
assert direct['url']==wheel.as_uri()
assert direct['archive_info']['hashes']['sha256']==sys.argv[2]
members=[]
with zipfile.ZipFile(wheel) as z:
 for name in z.namelist():
  if name.startswith('agentsync/') and not name.endswith('/'):
   p=Path(d.locate_file(name)).resolve();assert p.is_relative_to(root)
   expected=hashlib.sha256(z.read(name)).hexdigest();assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected
   members.append({'path':name,'sha256':expected})
assert members
print(json.dumps({'version':d.version,'origin':agentsync.__file__,'direct_url':direct,'members':members,'dependencies':sorted((x.metadata['Name'],x.version) for x in md.distributions())}))
